column1: # OpenText VuGen messaging/streaming protocol functions for JMS
# Functions with APEX Load protocol equivalents map to jms_*/ws_*/grpc_* actions; setup
# calls with no replay-visible side effect are preserved as native no-ops.

column4: reason]
JMS connection setup is preserved as a native no-op; broker config is supplied through script config.
JMS disconnect is preserved as a native no-op; APEX Load tears down the JMS protocol at replay end.
JMS connection creation is preserved as a native no-op; broker config is supplied through script config.
JMS session creation is preserved as a native no-op; APEX Load manages sessions internally.
JMS send maps to a native jms_publish action.
JMS publish maps to a native jms_publish action.
JMS receive maps to a native jms_consume action.
JMS consume maps to a native jms_consume action.
JMS request/reply maps to a native jms_request_reply action.
JMS acknowledge maps to a native jms_ack action.
JMS commit maps to a native jms_commit action.
JMS rollback maps to a native jms_rollback action.
WebSocket connect maps to a native ws_connect action.
WebSocket send maps to a native ws_send action.
WebSocket receive maps to a native ws_receive action.
WebSocket ping maps to a native ws_ping action.
WebSocket close maps to a native ws_close action.

gRPC connection setup is preserved as a native no-op; target config is supplied through script config.
gRPC disconnect is preserved as a native no-op; APEX Load tears down the gRPC protocol at replay end.
gRPC invoke maps to a native grpc_unary action unless a stream variant is indicated.
gRPC call maps to a native grpc_unary action unless a stream variant is indicated.
gRPC unary call maps to a native grpc_unary action.
gRPC server stream maps to a native grpc_server_stream action.
gRPC client stream maps to a native grpc_client_stream action.
gRPC bidirectional stream maps to a native grpc_bidi_stream action.
